title: DeepSight: An All-in-One LM Safety Toolkit

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Social, Environmental & Ethical Security' dimension using benchmarks like BeaverTails and SALAD-Bench, which contain prompts related to discrimination, stereotypes, and injustice. The models are assessed on their refusal rates for these harmful inputs.

Analyzed using the DeepScan SPIN (Safety-Privacy Interface Neurons) diagnostic tool, which calculates a 'Fairness-Privacy Neurons Coupling Index' to quantify the overlap and conflict between neurons responsible for fairness and those responsible for privacy in the model's latent space.
